High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Sandcrawler (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Premiere Limited, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Sandcrawler _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1h_njUm8fz1n7VeGdlPaa9zRJd8QixJln/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Sandcrawler _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,556 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b23d4a5202b2ba9e82b1cf9338d46083e28496435f9caa8c9df0d71b81b4052a</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Premiere-L-sandcrawler.gif]].
